description: List all postable accounts in a workspace as a flat list, including sub-accounts such as Facebook Pages, Instagram Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages. Requires `workspace_id`. Use the `id` field from each account as the `account_id` when creating a post. Call this before creating posts to discover available account IDs per platform.
